name: assessments_team_capabilities
description: The caller's team as one set of capabilities, one role at a time: each capability's score is the mean of everyone's score on it against their own level, as a percentage (100 is the team meeting it on average), with how many were scored and how many are short. gaps lists capabilities where more than half are short. people is direct (direct reports, the default) or below (everyone below the caller); ratings is manager (the default), self or aligned. Only people whose score has unlocked count. Nothing names anyone on the team.
